name: Ichimiya Yuzuki
source:
A boy often called "Prince" by his female classmates. Leito, who is often with him, is called his "Knight." It's because of his appearance and personality that he received his nickname.

He has a sociable but bitter personality. He's the type that cares about the evaluation of those around him and whether he wins or loses.

Although Leito has been close to him since he transferred schools, Yuzuki holds a strong interest in Nao.

[Translated and edited from [url=http://b-cluster.eek.jp/requartz/character/yuzuki.html]official wesbite[/url]]
